verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's own ClickStack AI Notebooks let a user describe an issue in plain language, and an AI agent queries logs, traces and metrics to surface data, charts and summaries inside the product. However, this is only a waitlist offering, and it is scoped to observability data. AI Functions are likewise only in private preview, and the MCP server connects external assistants rather than giving insights in-product. Missing for 10: general availability, in-product insights over arbitrary analytical data (not just observability), documented suggestion or recommendation features, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You can describe an issue in plain language, and the AI agent will query logs, traces, and metrics on your behalf — surfacing relevant data, charts, and summaries as a series of tiles.
Sign up for private preview access to AI Functions and the AI Inference Service in ClickHouse Cloud.
